name: @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway
description: Private Cloudflare Worker for the Kaspa x402 testnet gateway.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/server run build && npm run build:self
scripts.build:self: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:self
